tagline.id: Heat exchanger untuk memanfaatkan panas buang insinerator pada proses produksi RDF.
tagline.en: A heat exchanger that recovers waste heat from an incinerator in an RDF production line.

problem.id: Gas buang insinerator membawa panas yang terbuang begitu saja, padahal proses produksi RDF membutuhkan energi panas.
problem.en: The incinerator's flue gas carries heat that is simply lost, while the RDF production process needs thermal energy.

approach.id: Konsep proses dan perhitungan perpindahan panas, divalidasi dengan simulasi CFD, lalu diterjemahkan menjadi desain mekanik heat exchanger lengkap dengan blower dan monitoring suhu berbasis ESP32.
approach.en: Process concept and heat-transfer calculations, validated with CFD, then turned into a mechanical heat-exchanger design with a blower and ESP32-based temperature monitoring.
